slides.headline: One chat for every AI model you use
slides.say: Wait... you can chat with many AI models on your own server? Yes. You really can.

slides.headline: One interface for all AI chats
slides.body: Connects Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, local models, plus agents, code tools, and web search.
slides.say: It puts every AI model you use into one chat window, with agents that can run code and search the web.

slides.headline: 46,596 GitHub stars
slides.body: MIT licence · Written in TypeScript · Since February 2023
slides.say: It has over 40 thousand stars on GitHub and uses the MIT licence.

slides.headline: Many features experimental, self-host required
slides.body: Agent workspaces and management API are beta; you must host it yourself.
slides.say: Key features like agent workspaces are still experimental, and you need to host it yourself.

slides.say: That was Day 29 of 100. Save this, send it to a friend, and follow, or you might not see us again. The full list is in my bio.
